程序包 org.bukkit.block.data.type

接口 RedstoneWire

所有超级接口:
AnaloguePowerable, BlockData, java.lang.Cloneable
public interface RedstoneWire extends AnaloguePowerable
'north', 'east', 'south', 'west' 代表该红石线与临近方块连接的方式.

原文： 'north', 'east', 'south', 'west' represent the types of connections this redstone wire has to adjacent blocks.
